mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 12-month moving average), a further decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts over the prior month signals weakening consumer confidence in the housing market, reducing aggregate demand and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing in payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicate a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth rate is below 0.5% and UNRATE rises above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and rising), a decline in retail sales by at least 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.0% and rising, and RSAFS declines by at least 0.5%.
